notes.title: Bloody trains - released!
notes.notes:
Hi! 
This is marginal act with my new game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185000/Bloody_trains/]Bloody trains[/url]. Bloody trains is a sitcom train attendant simulator. In Bloody trains you will ride through a small country and take care about your passengers. They will get hungry, uncomfortable and cold. You’ll need to manage that parameters. 

Not all passengers are peaceful and you will need to fight dangerous people. For that you have blowing suitcases as part of indirect fight system. With suitcases you will fight terrorists and scary bosses!

Hope you’ll like my project
Thanks! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185000/Bloody_trains/
